numerical_failure.observed_behavior: Calling ellipsoid_stats with all three semi-axes equal raises ZeroDivisionError: float division by zero at the line computing m = (a ** 2 * (b ** 2 - c ** 2) / ... in draw3d.py.
numerical_failure.expected_behavior: Returns the volume and surface area of a sphere when a = b = c, with no exception. The near-sphere value (10, 10, 10+1e-6) gives (4188.79062366541, 1256.6371452898388), consistent with the analytic sphere values.
trigger_conditions: all three semi-axes are equal, a = b = c (the ellipsoid degenerates to a sphere)
a = b = c = 10 with ski.draw.ellipsoid_stats(a, b, c)
the division by (b ** 2 - c ** 2) and related terms hits zero, giving float division by zero

input_output_examples.input: a = b = c = 10; ski.draw.ellipsoid_stats(a, b, c)
input_output_examples.expected_output: volume and surface area of a sphere of radius 10 (no exact numeric value stated in the passages)

numerical_characteristics.magnitude: Surface areas around 1.3e3 (about 400π for a=b=c=10) and volumes around 4.2e3 (about 4000π/3), with test cases up to ellipsoid_stats(17, 27, 169) giving surface about 37426
numerical_characteristics.tolerance: Tests tightened to assert_allclose atol=1e-6 for volume and surface (previously atol=1e-2 and 1e-1 for surface); the volume check for (17, 27, 169) still uses atol=1e-4
category_specific_evidence: Surface area of an ellipsoid is given by S = 4π·a·b·c·R_G(1/a², 1/b², 1/c²), where R_G is Carlson's symmetric elliptic integral (elliprg), as shown in the issue's In [34] computation.
The degeneracy occurs when a = b = c (the ellipsoid becomes a sphere), per the PR body and commit message.

ellipsoid_stats(10, 10, 10 + 1e-6) returned surface 1256.6371452898388 and volume 4188.79062366541, while the elliprg formula gave 1256.637061435917; 400π ≈ 1256.6370614, the expected sphere surface for radius 10.
New test added for equal semi-axes: ellipsoid_stats(10, 10, 10) asserts volume 4000π/3 and surface 400π with atol=1e-6.
Existing test values: ellipsoid_stats(6, 10, 16) expects volume 1280π and surface 1383.2828269179892359787; ellipsoid_stats(17, 27, 169) expects volume 103428π and surface 37426.253635465972897880.
The PR states the fix is for the degenerate case of the spheroid surface-area formula when a = b = c, and that it also improves test accuracy.
